conviction_note: Day two of a dilutive financing: a $45.5m registered direct with Rodman & Renshaw priced at $2.76 (Friday's close) closes on or about today, its buyers sit about 34% under water at $1.83 and get freely tradable shares into the window. That leans negative. Partly offsetting it, the company's 90-day issuance lock-up means the $72.1m left on the ATM cannot be drawn tonight, and the CEO's own purchase gets a Form 4 by 2026-10-07. Scaled number: abs 7 x (2x0.44-1) = -0.84. The findings sum to -0.4. The two agree in sign, and the scaled number is larger because it also carries this name's 32% next-day up-rate and its 13% ATR.
bar: sized against this name's own 31 comparable falls (median next close -1.26%, median |move| 3.15%, up-rate 32.3%) and its 14-day ATR of 13.2%, from the sealed baseline; no usable option chain (unusable_chain), so there is no implied move

cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: Before the 2026-10-05 session NXH announced a $45.5m registered direct (16.5m shares or pre-funded warrants at $2.76, plus 16.1m five-year warrants at $3.45) led by Highbridge, with CEO Lemonis participating. Alongside it came the mutual termination of the Fathom merger, the CFO's resignation (replaced by an Alvarez & Marsal interim CFO) and a cut in the ATM from $200m to $75m. The stock fell 25.4% on 10-05 and another 11% by 15:05 ET on 10-06, the offering's scheduled closing date, on 5.5x volume.

evidence.claim: Prospectus supplement: 11,243,511 shares + 5,241,997 pre-funded warrants + 16,123,189 warrants at $2.76 combined, ~$45.5m, Rodman & Renshaw best-efforts, delivery on or about October 6, 2026; ATM ~$72.1m remaining of $75.0m; 98.7m shares outstanding before
FWP: Highbridge led the offering, CEO Marcus Lemonis participating (shares only), ATM cut from $200m to ~$75m, Q3 gross margin expected to exceed 30%, warrants at $3.45 exercisable after six months
Fathom merger agreement of 2026-06-16 mutually terminated on 2026-10-05; 'current valuations would not appropriately reflect the fair value of either company'
CFO Brian LaRose resigned on 2026-10-05; Paul Kosturos of Alvarez & Marsal appointed interim CFO
ATM prospectus supplement reducing the JonesTrading Capital on Demand program to $75m

pipeline.next_dated_event: Lemonis Form 4 for his offering purchase, due by 2026-10-07 (two business days after the 2026-10-05 trade). Offering shares deliverable on or about 2026-10-06. Q3 results are only a Zacks estimate (2026-10-26), not company-announced
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A large insider Form 4 tonight beyond the FWP's participation (bullish), or an 8-K showing the offering failed to close or a new financing despite the lock-up (bearish).

positioning_check: Shares short 13,725,124 at the 2026-09-15 settlement (+6.2% vs 08-31), 5.2 days to cover, against 98.7m shares outstanding before the offering (~14%) (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NXH/short-interest?assetclass=stocks; outstanding count from the 424B5). The 09-30 settlement is not yet published and the position carried into this week's fall is unobservable. Options: no two-sided ATM quote and the put/call OI ratio is 0.01, so there is no skew read.

findings.finding: The $45.5m registered direct closes on or about 2026-10-06. 16.5m new shares and pre-funded warrants (about 17% of the 98.7m outstanding) reach buyers who paid $2.76 and are about 34% under water at $1.83, and they can trade them from the window's open.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The prospectus dates delivery 'on or about October 6, 2026', so the shares become sellable inside the 10-06 close to 10-07 close window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The fall that announced this offering (2026-10-05, -25.4%) was followed by -11.2% the next session (today). On 2025-10-09/10, two consecutive large falls were followed by -13.6% and then -1.3%. Own-history next-day median is -1.26%.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall on ~14m shares of volume ($27m) may already be buyers or hedgers selling ahead of delivery, so part of this supply is spent. If the price held all of it, the stock would sit near the bottom of a completed flush. The rest stays in play because the offering is 16.5m shares and the warrants at $3.45 give holders no reason to hold common this far under water.
findings.independence: The FWP names Highbridge, a hedge fund, as lead buyer, the type of holder that hedges warrant-bearing registered directs: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1130713/000114036126038562/ef20083294_fwp.htm

findings.finding: The company accepted a 90-day lock-up on issuing any common stock or convertibles from the offering's closing (2026-10-06), so the $72.1m left on its JonesTrading ATM cannot be drawn tonight or in the window. That closes the commonest second leg of supply.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The final 424B5 carrying the lock-up was filed on 2026-10-06, the drop day itself. The overnight audience reads it, where the intraday tape saw a $75m ATM supplement filed on 10-05 next to the offering.
findings.why_not_priced: The tape saw an ATM supplement filed the same day as the offering, which reads as more supply. The lock-up language in the plan of distribution says that supply is barred for 90 days. If the price held this, the 10-05 ATM filing would carry no overhang discount. Caveat: the lock-up is 'subject to certain exceptions' and the exceptions were not shown, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: The ATM supplement itself cuts the program from $200m to $75m, which also limits supply: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1130713/000114036126038554/ny20083282x1_424b5.htm

findings.finding: CEO Marcus Lemonis bought shares in the offering at $2.76 (FWP of 2026-10-05). His Form 4 is due within two business days, i.e. by 2026-10-07, and will show the size of a disclosed insider buyer now under water.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Section 16 Form 4 deadline: two business days after the 2026-10-05 trade, which is 2026-10-07, inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nasdaq insider summary shows 4 open-market buys and 0 sells in the last 3 months; no dated reaction to those in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: His participation is known, but not its size. A large number would read as a buyer under the stock. A token number adds nothing, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Nasdaq insider-trades summary, 4 buys / 0 sells over 3 months: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/NXH/insider-trades?limit=15&type=ALL

The 90-day issuer lock-up expires about 2027-01-04, after which the $72.1m ATM is usable again

baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline: 5.5x volume, ATR 13.2%, a 32% own next-day up-rate and a fresh, undigested dilution all point to continuation. The only offsets are the ATM lock-up and the insider Form 4, both small.
